role: Measures `impact` against the git history: for each commit that changed 2 to MAX_UNITS mapped units, how many of the other units it changed (code units, and test suites) `impact` of its other code units would have named. Run by hand: `.venv-codemap/bin/python scripts/codemap/measure.py [MAX_UNITS]`.
state: ROOT: the repository root (two directories up)
CACHE: build/codemap-history.json, changed units per commit id
toplevel: Module docstring, `from __future__ import annotations`, imports (json, subprocess, sys, Path), ROOT and CACHE, the scripts/codemap directory put on sys.path, `import inventory`, and `sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))` when run as a script.

units.does: Runs git in the repository with the given arguments and returns its standard output (empty on failure).
Maps each unit key of one file version (Swift through the inventory's Swift parser, other code through its script parser) to its hash.

(commit, changed unit nodes) for every non-merge commit, newest first. For a commit not in the cache it parses each changed Swift or script file before and after and takes the units added or whose hash changed; a version that fails to parse is left out. Writes the cache back.

Opens the index (open_index) and, answering from it (View over records, callers, units and stores), for every commit whose changed units still existing number 2 to MAX_UNITS (argument, default 25): for each changed unit, whether impact of any changed non-test unit in another file names it (code: a certain caller at any distance, a state partner or an alike unit; tests: the unit's suite is among the suites reaching it). Prints the commit count and, for code and tests, found of total and the percentage. Returns 0.

branches.cond: fewer than 2 or more than MAX_UNITS changed units
no changed code unit in another file

units.does: Memoized: (every certain caller at any distance, state partner and alike unit (Index.similar); the (file, class) suites of the tests reaching it) for a node.
